notes.title: Update to version 1.037!
notes.content:
Hello, Generals!

As some of you may know, I added the page for the new Home Wars, or [b]"Home Wars: Battlefield"[/b], to Steam.
I want to suggest the new game because if you liked this HW, especially its FPS/TPS component, you would surely like Home Wars: Battlefield even more!

To those who ask me what kind of game it will be, I quickly answer [b]"Helldivers 2 + Battlefield 4"[/b] (which are games that I love, by the way!)



[h3]CHANGES IN VERSION 1.037:[/h3]

- I noticed I didn't keep a couple of fixes when I changed the game engine in the last update, so I added them.

- I smoothed out the colliders of some buildings (campaign map) a bit because I noticed that the armies were getting stuck in certain convex corners.

- In the start menu I added a little reminder for the new "Home Wars: Battlefield", so those who don't read the updates will know about the new title.



[h3]IMPORTANT:[/h3]

If you love the concept of the "Home Wars" universe as much as I do, please help me spread the word about the game in development to other players.
[b]Please support the development of "Home Wars: Battlefield" by adding it to your WISHLIST and spreading the word.[/b]
Please feel free to post the link to the new game's Steam page in any environment where interested players might be able to find it.

Unfortunately, I don't have the money to do a marketing campaign, so I'll post a few ads here and there.
For this reason, I ask you, as a developer-friend, to advise other players to add "Home Wars: Battlefield" to their wishlist.

We can't let bugs destroy this game forever!

If you have any ideas for cheaply advertising the game, let me know, and I'll try to implement them.


[h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3]

notes.title: HWB: Third faction REVEALED! + Store page
notes.content:
Hello, my brave Generals!

I'm here to tell you 2 good news!

1) Soon, [b]I will finally publish the official "Home Wars: Battlefield" page on Steam in a few days![/b]
This is where [b]YOU[/b] come into play: when it's ready (I'll publish the news here), I need all the Generals capable of combat to enlist on the new battlefield!

2) Second news, juicier for many of you.
What will be the new third faction of the new Home Wars???
[b]The new "Home Wars: Battlefield" faction will be DINOSAURS!!![/b]

[h3]Why did I choose dinosaurs?[/h3]
First of all, dinosaurs are always cool! They are big, always hungry, and omnipresent in cinematography and video game imagination.
The second reason is that we all had AT LEAST ONE toy dinosaur in our childhood.

[h3]Will it be a cool faction?[/h3]
Of course, it is.

[h3]Why will it be a cool faction?[/h3]
It will be for several reasons:
- it will be playable by the player (all factions will be playable by the player).
- we all dreamed of shooting a T-rex, let's not lie!
- when it comes to killer beasts, the saying "bigger is better" is true.
- you can charge a tank using a Triceratops or flank a platoon as a Velociraptor!

[h3]Will it be a very powerful faction?[/h3]
Yes, but I will try to balance all the factions as much as possible.
In any case, there is no horde that napalm cannot purge!

[h3]What do I have to do to play it?[/h3]
Wait for my next post, here on HW, where I will announce the publication of the new page of "Home Wars: Battlefield".
[b]When the new page is online, press the relative "Add to Wishlist" button and wait for the day of the declaration of war![/b]

I am sure many will love this new faction, but I am equally sure others will be disappointed.
I know that I could have included a faction similar to the Automatons from Helldivers 2, but yes, they are already there! I am happy to bring you new dynamics as much as I can.
Anyway, if it makes you feel better, I have already started saving some mech and robot models for the fourth possible faction. However, it can only be developed if the game has a good response due to the vast time required for implementation.

I hope I have made your day, my brothers!

[b]In the meantime, I continue to work hard to create the most epic battlefield you have ever played![/b]

[h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG!
THE ONLY GOOD DINO IS A DEAD DINO![/h3]

notes.title: Update to version 1.036!
notes.content:
Hello, Generals!

In these months, you have pointed out to me that the game has problems starting.
Initially I was not too worried, because I know that this problem has always existed, but it affected very few players and I also never understood how to solve it, because I can never replicate it on my machines.
However, since I updated the game engine (Unity) in the hope of improving the experience for all users, I noticed that many more players were unable to start the game.

Even in this case, I could not replicate the problem on my computers, but something had to be done! I could not allow the hecatomb of insects to stop!

Consequently I opted for the most logical thing: [b]I brought Home Wars back to the original game engine, trying to maintain all the improvements I had made in the last updates.[/b]
It really took me a long time, but it was the right thing to do for those who believed in me and in this project.


[h3]CHANGES IN VERSION 1.036:[/h3]

- [b]The game engine has been brought back to 2017! We are back to Unity 5.4![/b]
I know it's always a paradox, but maybe it's the most stable way to play HW.
Let me know if you notice a performance degradation, thanks.

- [b]I tried to keep all the improvements of the latest updates[/b], but I definitely missed something, so if you notice it, let me know!

- I remember that some people complained about problems in the initial menu, I think they said they couldn't see/press some buttons.
[b]I made some changes to the anchors of the various screens[/b]; tell me if it's better or worse now, especially for those with resolutions other than 16:9.


I want to point out that this great effort does not bring me any significant economic advantage, perhaps a few fewer refunds.
I did it because before being a developer, I am a gamer, or rather I would say a super gamer!
I know what it means to have your smile fade because of a game that does not start, which is why, for me, this type of problem has priority in being solved.

[b]I take this opportunity to remind you to stay tuned with the news, because I am working assiduously on the new "Home Wars: Battlefield", even if I am encountering several problems in the development of the multiplayer component, which however I absolutely want to include.[/b]


The war against insects continues, my friends, and we are certainly not the ones to give up!

[h3]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A DEAD BUG![/h3]

notes.title: Start of development "HOME WARS: BATTLEFIELD" + survey!
notes.content:
"Gooooood morning, Vietnaaaam!"

Here we are!!!

[b]Finally finally finally finally back to developing a new chapter of the Home Wars universe![/b]

A few days ago I started developing the new Home Wars: Battlefield and I must say that the warrior spirit of when I developed the first title has returned to me.

I want to point out that this game will not be a "Home Wars 2", but will be a separate chapter, totally focused on battles!

Below are some questions and answers to clarify your ideas.


[h3]WHY A CHAPTER FOCUSED ONLY ON BATTLES?[/h3]
There are mainly two reasons:
1) Developing HW2 would take me too long and now I can't afford it financially.
2) I would like to develop the battlefield part well and then transfer everything to the future HW2 and save some time.
Furthermore, I have the opportunity to test some totally new features compared to HW1.

[h3]WHAT NEW FEATURES WILL BE PRESENT?[/h3]
1) There will be (I hope) at least [b]3 factions[/b]: the toy soldiers, the insects and... mystery!
2) I'm working hard to introduce [b]multiplayer[/b]! It's my dream to develop a battlefield-style game, but [b]PvE[/b], I just hope the networking supports more than 4 players.
Obviously, single-player mode will also be available.
3) [b]Naval battles[/b]!
4) All factions will be [b]playable[/b]!
5) The toy soldiers will have movement animations; no more pedestals!
6) Translations into many languages.


[h3]SURVEY:[/h3]
This is the first of a series of surveys that I will propose to you to create gameplay as close as possible to your tastes, so stay connected for future surveys.
Reply many!

[b]1)[/b] If I could develop multiplayer successfully, do you think 4 players would be enough?
Obviously, the 4 (or more) players would be part of a much larger army, I hope almost 100 vs 100.

[b]2)[/b] At least at the beginning, I would prefer to implement open maps, like islands, and then maybe later, I could create some home maps.
There won't be a workshop, sorry, but it's too long to implement, but everything you want to include in the game, I can create it! :)

[b]3)[/b] Friendly fire or not? I say in multiplayer.

[b]4)[/b] Do you want the insect faction to be "realistic" like HW1 or a little more fantasy like Helldivers 2?

[b]5)[/b] What factions would you like besides soldiers and insects?

[b]6)[/b] Is it a problem if there are no animations such as reloading weapons?
As you know, I'm a solo developer, and making tiny animations like reloading weapons would take up a lot of my time. Plus, they won't be as nice as other games.
I thought the soldier could lower the weapon long enough to reload and then return to the firing position.
I can't use external animations because my models are designed to have as few bones as possible in the animations so as to improve performance and maybe insert more bots to create more chaos!

[b]7)[/b] The basic idea would be that the player starts with few choices when it comes to battle, but by collecting experience, he will be able to unlock each unit (vehicles, aircraft, ships, submarines, insects and who knows what! :D)
What do you think?
In this way, the game loses some of the immediacy of the gameplay but gains considerable longevity (I love unlocking things in video games)!


[b]I hope you have read everything; reply in large numbers because it is very important for me to know your opinion![/b]

When I have something to show you, I will publish the game page on Steam.

[b]Stay tuned![/b]

[b]THE ONLY GOOD BUG IS A F*****G DEAD BUG!!![/b]

notes.title: New HOME WARS! Do you prefer HW: COMMANDO or HW: BATTLEFIELD???
notes.content:
Hello Generals!!!

[b]Finally, I can go back to developing a new Home Wars![/b]

As much as I would like to develop "Home Wars 2" right away, that's not possible at the moment.

[h3]Why can't I develop Home Wars 2 now?[/h3]
HW is a game composed of 3 different gameplay styles, namely turn-based strategy, real-time strategy, and first/third-person shooter.
As you understand, it is an extremely long and complex project to develop, especially with all the fantastic ideas that you have suggested and which I will include.

[h3]Is there another reason why I'm not developing Home Wars 2 yet?[/h3]
I would like HW2 to have many new features. Among these are a physics-based system, naval units, playing as an insect, being able to play soldiers against soldiers, and much more.
All these features are risky to insert them all together for the first time, because they risk ruining the rest of the game.
Solution? I thought about introducing them gradually, one game at a time, so as to arrive at HW2 with the right experience to better integrate them and make a "definitive" Home Wars!

[h3]What are the options?[/h3]
I have two projects in mind to start testing the new features:
- [b]Home Wars: COMMANDO[/b]
- [b]Home Wars: BATTLEFIELD[/b]

[h3]What is Home Wars: COMMANDO?[/h3]
HW Commando is a sort of "Yet Another Zombie Survivors" set in the world of Home Wars.
There will be very different mechanics, also because I want to insert a sort of campaign linked to the neighborhood and not just to a single house.
There will be lots of weapons, lots of Helldivers style mounts (no code to enter) and most likely vehicles too.
I had already started developing this title, but I had to stop to finish the development of my latest game "Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood".

[h3]What is Home Wars: BATTLEFIELD?[/h3]
HW Battlefield is, just to give you an idea, a sort of "Ravenfield" set in the world of Home Wars, but with maps not necessarily linked only to domestic environments.
Here, the naval units will be present for the first time, and I will test the mode where soldiers fight against other soldiers (and, if desired, also insects against insects).
The development of this title would take longer than the previous title.

[h3]Why is this post coming now?[/h3]
As I said, [b]my latest game "Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood" was released on May 24th[/b] and I highly invite you to check it out.
Among other things, if you want to support me in the development of new hardware, this is the best way for now.
Having finished development and being able to start dedicating myself to a new title (although I will obviously continue to create content for MOTK), I thought I'd ask you which of the two you preferred.
For various reasons, I will be the one to decide which title to develop first due to personal and work dynamics, but, as always, I care very strongly about your opinion.

Having said that, let's bring these little plastic heroes of ours back into the limelight, [b]not for Democracy, but to truly defend our Home![/b]

See you soon, my fellow warmongers!

[b]"The only good bug is a dead bug!" forever![/b]

notes.title: HOME WARS: BATTLEFIELD or HOME WARS: SURVIVORS???
notes.content:
Hello, Generals!

It's a period in which I'm reviewing all my work projects, especially those involving toy soldiers.
I will definitely develop HW2 one day, but since it is practically 3 types of games in 1, the development time is immense and I can't afford it now.

However, not developing HW (for now) doesn't mean not developing toy soldier themed titles, given that you like them a lot.

The other day, I introduced you to [b]HOME WARS: SURVIVORS[/b].
If you want to know more, just read the post preceding this one.

Today, I want to offer you another title that you might like: [b]HOME WARS: BATTLEFIELD[/b]!
The game would be a sort of classic [b]single-player Battlefield[/b], or if we want Ravenfield, which has toy soldiers as protagonists.
The genre would be a [b]first-person shooter[/b] with the addition of a fun mode, which I won't reveal to you for now.
I'm not sure whether to use modern weapons and vehicles or those from WW2.
One thing that many will like would be, finally, [b]the presence of naval units, including submarine ones[/b]!
Being part of the HW universe, [b]I could also include insects as a faction, creating a sort of Starship Troopers[/b].

In case you like the idea, in the future, I will ask you some questions to meet your wishes, for example (it would be great if you started answering these already):
[b]1)[/b] Would you prefer the soldiers to have the usual pedestal or to run normally?
[b]2)[/b] Would you like animations, such as loading or jumping, to be minimized so you can spend time adding more content?
[b]3)[/b] Do you prefer WW2 weapons, modern ones, or a mix of both?


Obviously, I will have to personally decide which title to develop first, based on the development time and the needs I will have in the future, but, as always, I will take your opinion into great consideration! <3

If you want to support my work, I remind you of the latest games I released so that you can check them out:
- Age of Undead
- Gummy Dummy Battles
- Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood

I'm eager to hear what you think about this possible HOME WARS: BATTLEFIELD!
See you in the comments!

notes.title: SLOW RETURN TO NORMALITY
notes.content:
Hello, my friends!

Since I published the news about the flood I suffered, I have received more interest (likes and comments) than any update made in recent years!

[b]This made me extremely happy and made me understand that in addition to the developer-player bond, there is a bit of love <3[/b]

For this reason, I want to work even harder to make sure that in the future, when you open one of my games, you will feel it more fun, warmer, and with the feeling that it was developed by one of you!



[h3]FLOOD REPORT:[/h3]

If you are interested in getting some images of what happened, search for "Campi Bisenzio flood 2023".

The situation has not yet returned to normal, but the water has receded from almost every area and most of the mud has been taken away to allow road transport, so the first conclusions of this disaster can be drawn.

Eight people have died, hundreds of families are currently homeless, and the damage is calculated in the order of hundreds of millions of euros.



[h3]HOW DID IT HAPPEN?[/h3]

When storm Ciaran hit Tuscany on November 2, 2023, the rain began to fall with rare violence.
I remember I was out with my dog, and I was talking to my mother on my cell phone when the rain started hitting the umbrella with such force that we couldn't hear each other anymore, not even screaming.

Statistics say that two months' worth of rain fell in just two hours...
I honestly don't know if it's true, but I guarantee you that a lot... a lot... has fallen.

Many towns in the Florence-Prato-Pistoia plain were flooded simultaneously and by different rivers, a sign that the quantity of water on the ground was truly unmanageable.

In my town, Campi Bisenzio, the rivers have both burst their banks and overflowed.
Many areas were inundated with more than 150 cm of water.
In the case of my house, the water did not exceed 50 cm, but it was the most affected by the mud, as an old wall broke in at least 3 points, completely letting the water flow out.

In my street, we found ourselves having to shovel like 30 cm of mud everywhere in the house, garden and street.
I'm not a thin guy, but I guarantee you that wet mud weighs a lot, especially if you don't sleep at night and if the humidity gets into your bones, day after day.



[h3]WHAT DID I SEE THAT I DIDN'T EXPECT TO SEE?[/h3]

I saw a lot of solidarity.
Honestly, with the way the world is going, I didn't expect to see so many people willing to roll up their sleeves to help other people from nearby countries.
We received the help of thousands of volunteers of all ages, who made themselves available to shovel the mud, to bring basic necessities and to finance these operations.

I also saw absurdly comical scenes like a group of volunteers trying to clear out an underground garage with buckets... without realizing that the water came back under their feet every time :D

Unfortunately, there have also been many episodes that make you lose all hope for the human race, such as the fact that there have been looting actions, that there have been thefts of food items intended for flood victims and that cars have been stolen pretending to be emergency units.



[h3]EFFECTS ON THE BODY?[/h3]

Talking with the other inhabitants of my area, I discovered these consequences, some obvious, others curious:
- common back pain due to moving weights.
- intense pain in hands and feet due to continuous contact with water; we are talking about at least 7 days.
- difficulty sleeping in the rain.
- feeling of nausea when you hear water flowing, whether it is a small stream or a high-pressure washer.

In my case, having been the only one able to clean the house for many days, I now find myself with a fixed backache. I have no strength in my hands, and as soon as it becomes evening, I get constant pain inside the bones of my hands and feet, so much so that it is impossible for me to return to sports for at least another week.



[h3]WHAT HAPPENS NOW?[/h3]

I can finally go back to work most hours of the day now, even if it will take another week to finish the cleaning.



[h3]WHAT ARE THE ONGOING PROJECTS?[/h3]

Just to summarize, in addition to updating the games already released, there are 2 projects I'm currently working on:

- [b]"Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood" has already been released but is still in Early Access[/b]. In particular, I must add the Story mode, which enriches the gameplay and justifies the battles.

- [b]A Battlefield-style game, but single-player, with both first-person and tactical components, as in BF2 and BF4.
I tell Home Wars lovers to follow this latest title (not yet available) in the future because, among the factions present, there will also be insects and perhaps even dinosaurs! Both as enemies and as fully playable units![/b]
Furthermore, I will need this game to test some dynamics that I would like to introduce in HW2, such as physics and first-person in the invertebrate units.

In reality, I have a thousand other ideas, but being a single developer, it's very difficult to manage everything, so I'm forced to nip some very cool ideas in the bud, perhaps hoping to realize them in the future.



[h3]DO YOU WANT TO SUPPORT ME?[/h3]

Do you know those developers who managed to become millionaires with a single game (due to skill and luck)? ... well, it's not me! :D

[b]If you want to support me, there are 3 ways:[/b]

- Check out my latest games and see if there's any you're interested in!
Please buy for your own pleasure and not out of compassion for what just happened to me. Ultimately, I received very little damage compared to other families affected by the flood.

- If you like one of my games, it would be great if you left a review to encourage other potential players to purchase!

- Good old word of mouth!
I certainly can't invest in advertising now, so good word of mouth would be very helpful to me at this moment <3



[h3]CONCLUSION:[/h3]

What doesn't kill you strengthens you... but it tires you out a lot... :D

[b]I REALLY thank you from the bottom of my heart for being close to me at this moment, and I promise that I will try to reciprocate this love with healthy fun in the months/years to come![/b]

Talk to you in the next updates, my dear keyboard friends! <3

notes.title: Update to version 1.035!

Hello, Generals!

In this update, I focused on a unit that I see as underestimated (at least from videos and posts) but which is very powerful: the Observer!

[h3]CHANGES IN VERSION 1.035:[/h3]

- Cruise missile travel time decreased, but its blast radius was slightly reduced.

- The Smoke Grenade has a shorter recharge time, thus increasing its tactical contribution.

- The Laser-Guided Bomb still has its small explosion radius, but now it deals even more damage.

- Artillery Volley has slightly increased the radius within which projectiles can fall, so it has less accuracy.
However, his strikes are a little more powerful.
God bless artillery!

- The Support Crate should now have fewer problems descending, as previously it could "disappear" by touching certain surfaces above its desired landing point.


[h3]NEWS:[/h3]

My first pixel art game "Mercenaries of the Kingdom: First Blood" has just been released in Early Access.
I'd love it if you would take a look at it.
I hope you enjoy :)


Have a great Halloween, and see you in the next update, my friends!

notes.title: Mercenaries of the Kingdom
notes.content:
[b]Party-based rogue-lite RPG[/b] set in Earthial, a fantasy world. [b]Hire various races of mercenaries, equip them, create battle formations,[/b] and grab the loot! You are a mercenary hired to save the world from a mysterious threat from the North. Good luck, my friend!

- [b]6 races[/b]: Humans, Orcs, Light Elves, Dark Elves, Dwarves, Goblins.

- [b]12 magical knowledge[/b]: Fire, Water, Earth, Ice, Electricity, Poison, Light, Darkness, Cosmos, Vampire, Demon, Hellfire!

notes.title: HOME WARS update to version 1.030!
notes.content:

This is a quick update, just to change a couple of things.

I added an initial panel that will appear up to 3 times, to push new players to review the product and to offer everyone my last 2 titles: Age of Undead and Gummy Dummy Battles.

Then I took a good look at the old scripts, and I understood where I could get my hands to optimize the product a bit and where it is better to avoid doing it.
If, by rereading the scripts, I have the opportunity to solve some simple bugs, that's welcome, but otherwise, I prefer to avoid modifying a code of which I have little memory now.

[b]After evaluating many aspects, I have decided, with EXTREME JOY, to put HOME WARS 2 in the development queue![/b]

We are continuing to update the game because we want to win this damn war!
Here are the news that this update brings:

- As many of you have asked, we have implemented the possibility to deploy groups of units!

- The Sapper is a very special unit, but it’s often overpowered.
We have tried to balance it by increasing the cost of its buildings and modifying some variables.
We also need your feedback on this fix, so let us know how it goes. 

- We have increased by a little the hitbox of the following enemies:
Formica fusca
Solenopsis invicta

If you like the game, please review it on our store page; we need it.
Thanks Generals!

Until you have air in your lungs and plastic in the warehouse, you have to fight!

notes.title: Home Wars update to version 1.004
notes.content:
Hi Generals!

With this update we hope to solve the launch-crash problem that some of you had.
It's probably a resolution error and this update should solve it.

If you continue to have this problem, please try to:
- set a lower video quality than the current video quality, in the screen before the game launch.
- run the game as admin (right-click on the Home Wars icon on Desktop and then press "run as admin").
- add the game (the whole folder of the game and the process Home Wars.exe) to you antivirus' exclusions list.
- if it's not the first time you run the game, uninstall it and then reinstall it to make sure you don't have corrupted files.

Some computers make take longer to launch the game (even 2 minutes) due to the graphics card, especially on the first launch, so please just wait. If you get the Windows "Program is not responding..." screen, press "Wait for the program to respond".

We apologize for the inconvenience and we hope this update will solve the problem.
Let us know if it works.
Thank you in advance for your cooperation.

notes.title: Home Wars update to version 1.002
notes.content:
Hi Generals!
This is the second update of Home Wars, and here are the changes:

- The dynamite sound bug has been solved

- In Settings/Game you can now customize the plane's pilot sensitivity and invert the vertical axis. This setting can not be changed during the battle.

- As many of you have asked, we have increased the maximum limit of units that you can use in the battle.
Now the limits are:
200 for the Allies
1000 for Bugs
As a result, the allies/bugs ratio in the Campaign has also changed, so update your Settings /Game/max units.

- In the Campaign, the experience at the end of the battle is no longer 20 Exp, but is proportional to the quality and quantity of the killed enemies.
Bloody battle = more Experience!

- As you have asked, the time span between the beginning of the battle and the beginning of the enemy spawn, it has been increased.

- The Sapper turned out to be overpowered, so from now on it won't be able to place its structures near enemies.

Generals do your part! Protect your homes!
Good luck!
